title: SyntheticAI Telemetry Event
description: Defines the canonical telemetry event format ingested by the SyntheticAI threat-intelligence platform. All endpoint agents, SIEM forwarders, and third-party integrations MUST conform to this schema when submitting events to the /api/telemetry endpoints.

device_id.description: Unique identifier for the reporting device or agent instance.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the event was observed on the endpoint.

event_type.description: Category of the observed endpoint event.

process_name.description: Name of the process that generated or is associated with the event.

parent_process.description: Name of the parent process in the process tree.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the relevant file, if applicable.

file_path.description: Full filesystem path of the file involved in the event.

source_ip.description: Source IP address for network events.

destination_ip.description: Destination IP address for network events.

destination_port.description: Destination port number for network events.

dns_query.description: Domain name queried during a DNS resolution event.

registry_path.description: Full registry key path for registry modification events.

registry_value.description: Value written to the registry key.

user_name.description: Name of the user account under which the event occurred.

command_line.description: Full command-line string used to launch the process.

threat_score.description: SyntheticAI-computed threat confidence score. 0.0 = benign, 1.0 = confirmed malicious.

mitre_tactic.description: MITRE ATT&CK tactic identifier associated with the event.

mitre_technique.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique identifier associated with the event.
